grammar_lessons.title: Present simple: daily routines
grammar_lessons.explanation: Use the present simple for habits, routines and facts. With he, she or it, add -s or -es to most verbs.

question.explanation: Use works with he, she and it in the present simple.

grammar_lessons.title: Urdu greetings
grammar_lessons.explanation: Urdu greetings change with context and formality. السلام علیکم is a widely used respectful greeting.

question.explanation: آپ کیسے ہیں؟ is a respectful way to ask how someone is.

reading_passages.title: A morning at the market
reading_passages.text: Sara goes to the market on Saturday. She buys apples, bread and milk. The market is busy, but the shopkeeper is friendly.

questions.prompt: When does Sara go to the market?
